en.text: Relevant character names from the game Deadlock.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
I'd be happy to put any of you on my payroll.
That was one hell of a fight.
Glad it went the way it did.
That could have gone bad, but we kept it together.
It was fun working with you guys.
Well aren't we a fun bunch of malcontents?
This is everyone's first time summoning an elder god, right?
I'm not trying to be cocky, I'm just saying, on paper our team should totally kick the shit out of them.
I don’t suppose anyone wants to place bets on who dies first.
We are gonna pick them off one by one.
If they think they're winning they're in for some serious disappointment.
They can't out run my mind.
Ready to show 'em who they're dealing with.
If we catch someone on their own, they're as good as dead.
You just can't stop that guy…
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
Be with you when I can bebop
They took out the Chess Guy!
I like the way you think, Paradox.
They took out the Test Pilot!
That could have been real bad.
Hate to be on the receiving end of that.
You and your creepy arm have fun
Geist has 'em jut where she wants 'em.
He uh… he wasn't messing around.
Good job, Seven, you just… keep killing everyone…
Glad the OSIC isn't hunting me..
Feels good working together again, doesn't it?
You were born for this, Infernus.
Admit it, Infernus, you're having fun.
I'll be back when I can Fern
They can't be happy about that.
Looks like someone took their arthritis medication.
Not gonna lie, I was making fun of the bow until I saw you use it.
Grey Talon was looking out for us…
They took out the Rat King!
That guy knows how to use a knife.
They don't have an answer for Shiv!
Don't get in too much trouble kid
Told you we'd make a good team, Ivy.
We should work together more often.
There goes one weird pile of goo..
Glad that thing's on our side…
That is one scary lady with a sword.
Glad you're on our side, Yamato!
You're not getting away with that.
Oh I see how it is!
The enemy could be here any second…
Gotta keep my eye out for the enemy…
I can't help anyone if I'm dead…
God that makes me feel alive…
I'm lucky I got out in one piece….
I'm not feeling good about this…
We can still figure a way out of this mess.
We just need to double down, what's the worst that could happen?
It's not too late to turn this around.
This is a bad time to have an off day.
We got time to turn this around.
We need to keep this up!
We keep fighting as a team, we'll win.
I'm not going out without a fight…
I need all the help I can get.
We gotta take 'em out or I'm dead…
Got time for one more trick…
No one is untouchable. No one.
Let go of me damn it!
What's it take to stop Abrams?
Gotta be faster than that, Bebop.
All you did was make yourself a target…
I expected more from you, Bebop.
You didn't really think that would get it done, did you?
You don't got what it takes, Paradox.
Cute trick. Next time try one that works.
I'll tear down all your machines, McGinnis.
How many of these things does she have?
They got the Rejuv, not great, but we can still work this out.
Geist is looking to drain life.
You can't hide from me, Haze.
I'm not scared of the feds.
You can't out smart me, Haze.
She probably thought she was safe up there…
You never should have came for me, Infernus.
You were never skating away from me.
Lash, if you can't stop Bebop you can't stop me.
You're making this too easy, Lash.
Now that's a job well done.
We need to keep the momentum going.
We can't afford to let up now.
And you thought you had a plan…
They thought that was going to be enough?
No one is stopping me from finishing the ritual!
There's no one better at what I do…
Go back to the cornfield, Holliday.
New York's not for everybody, Holliday.
You're not welcome in New York.
He's not going to forget that anytime soon…
That's one way to lose a customer…
Glad I'm walking away from that fight…
Try to hook me again and see what happens…
Paradox won't be bothering us for a while.
Shoulda stayed outta my way, Paradox.
Won't be seeing a black hole for a while…
Shoulda stayed in the classroom, Professor.
No rest for the wicked, kid.
You Blackmore kids are all the same.
Don't pick fights you can't win, Apollo.
I appreciate the confidence kid, but it's not enough.
Takes more than machines to stop me.
Don't need to worry about McGinnis for a while.
And she thought she was so smart.
Was never going to work out for you, Geist.
You picked the wrong lady to prey on.
You had a good run, Lady Geist, but it's my time now.
Just die with some dignity, Geist.
Hope I don't see that guy again soon…
I knew the feds were overselling how tough you were, Seven.
I wasn't looking to start anything with the OSIC.
Oh great, now I have heat with the feds.
This is gonna make running my business a lot harder…
Stay out of my head, Haze.
They got cocky and they paid for it.
I'm not some tourist you can pick off, Vindicta.
Put on some damn shoes, lady.
I thought you wanted out of the life, Fern.
This is what I get for believing you, Fern…
Shame, he was a helluva bartender.
You made me do that, Fern.
Thought you were supposed to be some hero, Kelvin.
Look when this all over I'll buy you a drink and say I'm sorry.
Thought you boys were smart enough not to take me on.
Lash, Lash, Lash… when are you gonna learn?
What's a matter, Lash? Thought you were a tough guy.
Keep running your mouth, Lash, it's only going to get worse for you.
You thought you could come for me Calico?
I thought we had an arrangement, Calico.
Calico is out of the picture.
Glad Sophie never got mixed up in her shit…
You got spirit, Graves, I appreciate that.
You wanted to sit at the big kid table, Graves? This is what it looks like.
You're a tough old bastard, aren't you, Talon?
Sorry about your family, Talon, but it's got nothing to do with me.
I can't let anyone stand in my way.
If he was in his prime I'd probably be dead…
Thought the Baxter Society hunted monsters…
You make a good looking corpse, Shiv.
When this is over I should ask about his stylist.
I won't let the Baxter Society get in my way.
You honestly thought you could stop me, Pocket?
Kid, you should be wasting your time at the pool hall, not getting shot at.
You didn't know who you were messing with, did you?
Keep coming at me, and I'll make Spanish Harlem the next place I set up shop.
Don't take the fall for Lenny, Celeste.
Why do I feel bad about shooting a pile of goo…
Oh Viscous. You were dumb but kind of adorable.
Nothing's scarier than a man with conviction.
I'm not a fan of zealots.
You think you can turn me in?
I'm not one of your bounties, Silver.
Get out of New York Wrecker
You're not getting a foothold in New York.
I don't bow to the 7th Moon.
We could have been friends, Yamato.
Your dreams of expansion have come to an end.
No one is better than me. No one.
You could at least try to make it a challenge…
Go home and save us all some time…
If you think this is impressive wait until I get going…
Feel free to give up any time.
No one is stopping me from getting what I want.
Oh god, everyone else is dead….
Well. Looks like it's up to me…
Well, looks like it's up to me.
I need to get out there.
I can't let them have all the fun without me…
I'll be back when I can.
I need to find a place to heal.
If you think I'd be worried about a sheriff from Missoula…
Wherever. The point is that I don't get scared by cops who probably just experienced running water for the first time in their lives.
I will repent all my wicked ways.
No I think you're a joke.
Just sell the damn book already.
Yeah yeah wrong hands blah blah . Abe: you're not the chosen one. Your just a guy who was dealt a bad hand… dump the book and get your life back.
Today's the best day for gambling. You really think if this goes sideways we're walking out of here alive?
No I'm thinking smart. When it comes to making wishes, you keep that shit as simple as possible to avoid loopholes.
Hey Bebop, you looking for work?
Why are you wasting your time at a junk yard.
How long are you planning on lying to that lady.
No, you just lie to yourself.
Well, in that case let's go out with a bang…
Oh it's going to be hilarious.
You know what I like about you Paradox? You don't just like to win. You like to do it with style.
I thought that was at the MET.

I know where you're going with this: here's the problem with gambling on body counts with you. You're a psychotic killing machine, which means if I incentivize you to kill more on top of that, there's a non zero chance that you don’t finish the ritual because you want to pad your numbers.
I really wanted to make it work
Between the two of us they don't have a chance in hell at escaping.
Glad you're on our side Drifter
No need to threaten me, I'm already scared of you.
This may surprise you Professor, but college kids like to have fun.
I don't suppose you're a gambling man Professor?
I mean I've killed people but it's not like a recreational thing for me.
Honey, I got you covered don't worry.
Tell ya what, you keep me from dying I'll give you the hat.
Why do you carry your pillow everywhere?
No, but your friend Spencer Fontaine owes me money.
I'd love to meet your father.
How do we make that happen?
You obviously don't know who I am.
I'm not worried. I got someone around your age that works for me, they're great at what they do. I assume you are too, otherwise the patron wouldn't ask you to be here.
Suppose now's not the time to ask for an introduction.
Bet your turrets can't keep up with me…
Ya know I'm used to working with people that are a little more subtle.
You know what the difference between us is?
I worked for what I have, it wasn't handed to me.
I had a marker on him, so not very long.
I don't suppose you have any moral issue with taking people out while they're helpless?
I think this'll work out just fine
If I gave you 50 bucks would you let me turn your hat into a roulette wheel?
I think you're on the run and desperate and might need 50 bucks.
You don't waste time with frivolity, got it.
Pragmatic. The word you're looking for is pragmatic.
You're not here for me, right?
I think "little" is underselling me a bit, but that's good to know
Anyone who says they aren't nervous when the stakes are high are either liars or morons.
That's why I do it. Nerves let you know you're alive.
Yeah you don't have to equivocate with me, I don't care. You're killing them out of principle right?
Have you considered killing people for money? Because boy do I have list for you.
You should. I think you'd be great at. Anyway, you ever want to chat about financial freedom you let me know
I believe in leading by example.
How you like being a ghost?
It is going to be offensive how fast we burn down their objectives
How's working at the boring bar.
He is. A good. Boring. Man.
It's ok, you can say it.
Practice that line more so next time you say it I might believe you.
You say contempt, I say managed expectations.
People say you're a noble man.
Noble men tend to get other people killed.
Hey, of all the people I could call markers on I chose you, and that should count for something.
I almost feel sorry for the poor bastards waiting for us in the lane.
Boys we don't talk about losing at the table.
Feeling's mutual. Now let's summon a god.
Mendoza said you were gonna take a dive in that fight.
I lost a lot of money.
And you're the guy that lost to Bebop.
One time's all it takes to be a loser.
One time's all it takes to be a loser.
I keep an ear out for interesting people. You're the girl who speaks to the dead.
You know that's not what I mean.
I got a bookie who's dead and I need to know where he put the spare key to his apartment, can you help or not?
That I've killed or my people killed.
Just trying to get a clearer picture.
Because I'm fair. And when you treat people fairly they know when the hammer comes down they have no one to blame but themselves.
Are you as dangerous as they say?
That when you retired you had more confirmed kills than anyone in The Baxter Society.
Oh, you're a fan of the 7th Moon.

Look Billy, I know that people give you shit for having a goat head and I just wanted to say that I really appreciate that whatever bet you lost to have that be the case you were man enough to follow through with the consequences.
If you didn't you're even dumber that I thought
What do you do for fun?
What do you do for fun? I mean, you say you hate everything but there has to be something.
So we can find common ground. Share some laughs. Bet on sports games then hold markers when you can't cover them. It's a whole thing but it all starts with building a connection, ya know.
Hey kid, when this is over if you're looking for work let me know.
It's nice to finally work with you.
Look, I'm a big fan of anyone who makes Mendoza's life hell. Relax, let's have some fun.
Try not to sound too excited.
That’s just because you haven't gotten to know me yet
I just want you to know that I tried to warn your friend.
You can't help that guy. Lenny's always-
He's a good guy. Helping you helps him.
Well tell him I say hi.
Oh, we'll live. Probably live. I think we'll live.
Well, I'm looking forward to this being the beginning of our relationship.
No one needs a relationship with anybody, but I think we can help each other out.
I mean, aside from connections with fashion editors, models, and anyone in the venn diagram of people with status who also have vices, sure. I got nothing.
It's not. But tell you what; if we complete the ritual we'll call things square.
Obviously. How much you wanna wager? A thousand?
I just want you to know that I'm fighting with you, not for you.
I mean afterwards. Your operation and mine don't need to be enemies.
Well this is off to a great start…
You need my help, why would you.
Honey, if you think I'm weak you really haven't been paying attention.
You were outclassed, simple as that.
Better people than you have tried to kill me…
You thought you could get up close with me?
You won't be lucky next time!
Next time I'll get 'em for sure…
I don't like the math here…
If they're going to leave it here, I'm going to take it…
I'll take whatever I can get…
I didn't forget what you did…
This is not what I needed.
Next thing you'll tell me I'm getting raided…
Nothing's going the way it was supposed to.
This is not going my way…
Something needs to change, and soon...
I have no one to blame but myself.
If you think crime doesn't pay, you are outrageously bad at crime.
No one builds an empire without sacrifice.
The great part about being a degenerate gambler is that you get really good at setting up your own action. Broke? Yes. Bored? Never.
I don't appreciate the news labeling some of my services as "rackets." Who wouldn't love being protected by me?
You think I handle money? Please, that stuff is filthy.
Blackmail sounds so sleezy. I prefer "information retention services."
Friends are just acquaintances you feel bad for extorting…
Some people say it's better to be feared than loved… those people totally get it.
I can get some new gear.
Wonder what I can get at the shop.
There has to be something at the shop I can use…
I need to use these souls I've saved up.
There's nothing I can't get at the shop…
One step closer to completing the ritual.
The ritual will be complete in no time…
We got the objective, that's what's important.
See, I bet you were going to do that - I just made five bucks.
That's fine, had some legs to break anyway.
It shouldn't take you too long to realize you made a mistake.
Good timing, I was planning on getting rid of some loose ends today anyway...
Can't help, I need to go over my ledger… people always underestimate how important the organized part of "organized crime" is.
So long as you don't mess with my business, we're good.
You need to find a craps or poker game, give me a call.
They're not gonna like this trick…
Who doesn't love a good card trick…
I don't need a gun to kill a man.
They'll be running from me in no time….
No one is gonna catch me…
I move with the speed of thought.
I know how to make an exit.
They can try to pin me down all they want…
If things go bad I'll be ready
Sometimes there's things to be said for brute force…
Time to line up a firing squad…
I got enough bullets for everyone…
If we're coordinated this will be devastating…
Gotta remember to use this after I have someone lifted…
If something's stationary it won't last long…
They're gonna squirm in the air.
Not much they can do about this…
I catch 'em alone they're all mine…
They're about to find out who they're messing with.
I won't have a lot of time, but it'll be enough…
Perfect way to start a fight…
I got tricks up my sleeve.
You never should have gotten close…
They can shoot me all they want…
They won't get to use their little tricks…
Let me show you what I'm capable of…
Let's see what this tommy gun can do…
